slash_art.slashexpansion.wan_jian_gui_zo: §7Summons dozens of phantom swords from above to pierce enemies within range. Count scales with player's experience level (10~256 swords), range 64 blocks.
slash_art.slashexpansion.senbonzakura.de: §7Conjures pink cherry-blossom illusion swords around each target, falling from above to impale them. 4~7 swords per target, range 30 blocks, can pierce.
slash_art.slashexpansion.rift_slash.desc: §7Dash forward at high speed, releasing 8 ring-shaped drive projectiles around you that knock back enemies. Comes with ender particles, combines mobility and attack.
slash_art.slashexpansion.frost_domain.de: §7Unleashes a frost domain (radius 20) centered on yourself, dealing magic damage to all enemies and applying Slowness X, Weakness III, and Mining Fatigue IV for several seconds.
slash_art.slashexpansion.inferno.desc: §7Summons hellfire to burn all enemies within 18 blocks, setting them on fire for 12 seconds. Deals 50% bonus damage to Nether mobs (Piglins, Hoglins, etc.).
slash_art.slashexpansion.zhan_tian_ba_ji: §7Slashes forward with a massive vertical blade, dealing 150% damage and launching enemies upward.
slash_art.slashexpansion.jian_dang_ba_hu: §7Sweeps a massive horizontal blade, dealing 150% damage and knocking enemies back.
slash_art.slashexpansion.geng_jin_jian_j: §7Summons golden flying swords to attack enemies. Sword count depends on the blade's refine level (1 per 10 refine, max 100), range changes with kill count (20 if <1000 kills, else 36), each sword deals 160% damage.
slash_art.slashexpansion.qi_sha_jian_jie: §7Creates a Seven-Kill Sword Realm domain, continuously damaging enemies within. Radius scales dynamically with the blade's kill count (3~64 blocks), larger with more kills.
